name: Location
definition: Entity is located in, based in, or situated at a geographic place.

name: Home Venue
definition: Sports facility serves as the home ground for a sports team.

name: Geographic Relation
definition: Physical relationship between natural geographic features such as rivers or mountains.

name: Organizational Membership
definition: Entity is a member of, part of, or affiliated with an organization, team, or military branch.

name: Political Affiliation
definition: Entity is a member of or affiliated with a political party.

name: Ownership/Subsidiary
definition: Entity is owned by, a subsidiary of, or acquired by another corporate entity.

name: Role/Position
definition: Entity holds a specific professional role, political office, or title.

name: Creator/Contributor
definition: Entity is the author, director, composer, architect, or developer of a creative work or project.

name: Family Relationship
definition: Kinship or familial connection between entities.

name: Award/Nomination
definition: Entity received or was nominated for an award, prize, or honor.

name: Event Participation/Outcome
definition: Entity participated in, won, or was the result of a competition, election, or event.

name: Distribution/Platform
definition: Entity is published, broadcast, released by, or compatible with a platform, network, or label.

name: Genre/Type
definition: Entity belongs to a specific category, class, or artistic style.

name: Language
definition: Entity is written, performed, or published in a specific language.

name: Character
definition: Fictional character appears in or is associated with a creative work.

name: Identity/Name
definition: Entity is an alternate name, version, translation, namesake, or alter ego of another entity.

name: Heritage Listing
definition: Entity is listed on a historic register or heritage list.

name: Subject/Field
definition: Entity is the subject of, or associated with a field of study or topic.

name: Temporal Relation
definition: Entity precedes, follows, or is associated with a specific time relative to another entity.

name: Comparison
definition: Entity is compared to another entity based on shared or contrasting attributes.

name: Related Works
definition: Entity is a related work or part of a series with another entity.
